test_connection.title: Supabase Connection Diagnostics
test_connection.subtitle: This page helps you verify the connection between the HorSet application and your local or cloud Supabase database.
test_connection.testing: Sending request to verify database connection...
test_connection.sql_advice: 💡 Recommendation: If database connection is successful but tables cannot be loaded, you might not have run the SQL script in your Supabase SQL Editor. Follow the instructions below.
test_connection.step1_desc: If you don't have a project yet, go to Supabase.com, sign up, and create a new project.
test_connection.step2_desc: Go to your Supabase project 👉 Settings > API, copy the keys, and edit the .env file in your root folder:
test_connection.step3_desc: Go to Supabase 👉 SQL Editor, select "New query", paste the entire contents of schema.sql, and click "Run" to set up tables, RLS policies, and triggers.
test_connection.step4_desc: Once the above steps are completed, click "Retest" above to verify the database connection is 100% operational.
test_connection.sql_helper_desc: For updating database policies if table loading fails. Copy and run directly in Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor.
test_connection.sql_helper_hint: You can open 'Supabase SQL Schema Helper' on the bottom-left to copy the script directly without opening project files.

line_settings.guide_subtitle_1: Steps to authorize bill delivery and tenant registration per independent property
line_settings.guide_step_1_title: ➡️ Create a Provider for your property
line_settings.guide_step_1_desc_1: Go to LINE Developers Console to register a developer account
line_settings.guide_step_1_desc_2: Click the Create Provider button (name the folder after your property to keep it organized)
line_settings.guide_step_2_desc_1: Go to the newly created Provider, click Create New Channel, and select Messaging API
line_settings.guide_step_2_desc_2: Complete the information for your property's bot
line_settings.guide_step_2_tip_title: 💡 If you already have a Line OA, you can start from this step:
line_settings.guide_step_2_btn_2: Go to LINE Official Account Manager 🟢
line_settings.guide_step_2_tip_item_1: • Log in and select your LINE OA
line_settings.guide_step_2_tip_item_2: • Move to the top-right menu named "Settings"
line_settings.guide_step_2_tip_item_3: • Go to the Messaging API section at the top
line_settings.guide_step_2_tip_item_5: • Select your Provider and accept the terms
line_settings.guide_step_2_tip_item_6: • Return to the LINE Developers Console and select your Provider
line_settings.guide_step_2_tip_item_7: • The Messaging API with your LINE OA name will appear. Click on it.
line_settings.guide_step_2_desc_3: Go to the Messaging API tab at the top
line_settings.guide_step_2_desc_4: Scroll down to the bottom under Channel access token (long-lived)
line_settings.guide_step_2_desc_5: Click Issue and copy the long security key to paste into the left field on this page
line_settings.guide_step_3_desc_1: Go to the Provider, click Create New Channel, and select LINE Login
line_settings.guide_step_3_config_1: • Region to provide the service = Thailand
line_settings.guide_step_3_config_2: • Company or owner's country or region = Thailand
line_settings.guide_step_3_config_3: • Channel name = Set as you prefer
line_settings.guide_step_3_config_4: • Channel description = Set as you prefer
line_settings.guide_step_3_desc_3: Click "I agree to the LINE Developers Agreement."
line_settings.guide_step_3_desc_4: Click "I have read and acknowledge LY Corporation Privacy Policy." and click Create
line_settings.guide_step_3_desc_5: Go to the LIFF tab at the top and click Add
line_settings.guide_step_3_config_6: • LIFF app name = Set as you prefer
line_settings.guide_step_3_desc_7: Click the Add button at the bottom
line_settings.guide_step_3_desc_8: Copy the LIFF ID to paste into the left field and save your settings
line_settings.guide_warning_1_title: 1. LINE Login status must be published (Set to "Published")
line_settings.guide_warning_1_desc: Initially, LINE Login is set to Developing (gray), making it accessible only to admins. General tenants will experience loading loops or failure to register. Solution: Click the gray status circle at the top right of the LINE Login page and set it to Published (green) before going live.
line_settings.guide_warning_2_title: 2. Endpoint URL for LIFF must have "/tenant-register" suffix
line_settings.guide_warning_2_desc: Make sure your Endpoint URL is complete and not just a naked domain, otherwise tenants will see "Unspecified room information" and won't be able to register.
line_settings.guide_warning_3_title: 3. Correct way to share registration links
line_settings.guide_warning_3_desc: When admins click "Generate LINE Link", copy the link and share it directly with tenants. Do NOT click the link to test and copy the browser URL to send to tenants, as the property and room information will be lost.
line_settings.guide_subtitle_2: Steps to enable slip notifications to admin and staff groups
line_settings.guide_substep_1_desc_1: Copy the Webhook URL from the blue box in Part 2 on the left side
line_settings.guide_substep_1_desc_2: Select your Messaging API Channel, find the Webhook URL field under the Messaging API tab, paste the URL and click Update. Then verify that "Use Webhook" toggle is enabled.
line_settings.guide_substep_2_desc_1: Go to the Basic settings tab, copy the Channel secret and paste it into the left field (used to verify the signature of LINE Webhooks to prevent unauthorized requests)
line_settings.guide_substep_3_desc_1: Each admin must add the bot as a friend and complete one of the following methods:
line_settings.guide_substep_3_method_1: 👉 Method 1 (Automated - Recommended): Click "Add LINE Admin Connection" on the left, generate a 5-minute 6-digit code, and send it to the bot in the chat room. The bot will automatically pair the account!
line_settings.guide_substep_3_method_2: 👉 Method 2 (Manual): Send #MYID command to the bot to receive your 33-character LINE User ID. Paste it into the manual input field on the left to verify and pair.
line_settings.guide_substep_4_desc_1: Invite your property's LINE OA account to your staff LINE group, then send the connection command (e.g. #CONNECT-...) in the group chat. The bot will automatically link the group and confirm the successful connection!
line_settings.auto_desc: The system will generate a temporary 6-digit password. Send this code to the property's LINE OA bot to automatically link your LINE ID and fetch your profile.

line_settings.step_auto_done: The system will automatically complete the setup without any extra clicks!
